scope: Counting accuracy for bundled skewer endpoints at restaurant/barbecue checkout
accuracyFindings: Duplicate/false markers and missed terminal faces were confirmed in a manually annotated region of a real photo.
Changing confidence, overlap filtering, aspect scaling or tiling has not established a reliable improvement on the available evidence.

A local build 2 candidate tightens NMS IoU from 0.7 to 0.45 at confidence0.25, preserving scaleFill and original weights. On two small same-image regions TP9/FN2 stay unchanged while FP13 drops to11; overall counting acceptance remains blocked.
requiredNextEvidence: Representative real restaurant endpoint-bundle photos with independent manual counts and endpoint labels; separate calibration and held-out validation.
initialDataRequest: 10–20 real endpoint-bundle photos to characterize failures and build a first independent evaluation set; not a claim that this is sufficient training data.
